outcome: Nucleated red blood cells (NRBC) in umbilical cord blood vessels
cohort: The study evaluated 250 placenta samples from pregnant women and their fetuses/newborns, retrieved from pathology archives.
finding: The study found significant associations between specific placental histopathological findings (fetal vascular malperfusion, maternal inflammatory response, maternal vascular malperfusion, and NRBC in umbilical cord blood vessels) and adverse maternal and fetal clinical outcomes such as intrauterine fetal demise, premature rupture of membranes, pre-eclampsia, and preterm labor, and also between maternal malignancy history and placental infarction or NRBC.
cross-section timing: Data were retrieved from the archive of the pathology department, reflecting clinical and pathological findings at the time of birth or pregnancy outcome.
